title: Pink Punk Hammer Girl
description: A three-panel layout displays the same pink-haired anime girl in different dynamic action poses. The central panel shows her leaping forward swinging a large purple hammer with purple and green energy bursts. The left panel shows a ready stance with the hammer resting on her shoulder. The right panel depicts her striking downward with a bright yellow impact flash.
prompt: Anime style illustration of a fierce punk girl with long bright pink hair and goggles, wearing a pink and black outfit with shorts, fishnets and boots. She wields a large purple cartoonish hammer with spikes. Shown in three separate panels on a grey background: left is a combat stance with hammer on shoulder, center is a powerful jumping attack pose with purple and green energy explosion behind her, right is a downward hammer smash creating a yellow starburst impact. Bold cel-shaded 2D animation style.
